name: AL Language XApp E
brief: Cross-app fixture E: an app with a JPEG logo that registers an assisted setup when the login raises OnRegisterAssistedSetup.
description: Holds the 8 x 8 JPEG app logo and one OnRegisterAssistedSetup subscriber (tests/al-language-onprem/session-system/UsAppLogoJpeg.al). Also holds one OnAfterLogin subscriber that sets the SingleInstance state of the AL Internals Test Fixture (tests/al-language-xapp-e/SirXeLoginSubs.al, al-runner 8696). Depends on the AL Internals Test Fixture, System Application and Base Application; no app depends on it. It is published last, after cross-app fixture T, so it changes no subscriber order of the other fixtures. The app id, name and publisher are fixed: the probe reads them.
